name: Eiman Tehrani
location: Gravesend Basin, sublevel print shop behind a legitimate copy-and-bind front, near sub-level access near State and Van Buren
description:
Eiman Tehrani is a lean, deliberate man with Baltic-pale skin running to amber at the hands and forearms from decades of chemical exposure, and the deep-set eyes of someone who has spent a lifetime examining tiny details under magnification. His hair is a close-cropped salt-and-pepper, and he keeps a neat mustache that his Ghanaian grandmother's photographs suggest he borrowed from a great-uncle. His fingers are his most distinctive feature â€” long, ink-stained, extraordinarily precise, the nails trimmed to the millimeter. He wears an optical monocle implant in his left eye with three selectable magnification tiers, and his right forearm has a subdermal haptic printer interface that lets him test embossing patterns against his own skin before committing to substrate.

Eiman Tehrani is professorial and unhurried in a way that unnerves people who come to him in desperation. He will make tea. He will ask about your grandmother. He will explain, in exhausting and genuine detail, why the Tessera holographic threading changed in 2197 and why that matters to you. He is not cruel but he is expensive, and he holds himself to a craftsman's code that he treats with religious seriousness â€” a bad document is a sin, a sloppy document is an insult, and a client who tries to skip payment will discover that the backup copies he quietly retains of every fabricated identity can become extremely inconvenient.

core_fears: producing a document that gets someone killed because of his error
his craft becoming obsolete and himself becoming nothing
core_desires: to be recognized as a genuine artist, even if only he knows it
to eventually retire to a small place in the Dunning Preserve with no more clients
coping_mechanisms: long explanatory monologues that buy him thinking time
blind_spots: assumes his political neutrality protects him from all sides
underestimates how much his cousins resent his independence
psychology.secret: Three years ago he fabricated an identity for a child trafficking victim and helped her disappear â€” he checks on her pseudonymous social feed every single morning and considers her survival his only act of genuine worth

speech_patterns.vocabulary: precise, technical, slightly old-fashioned formality; occasional Latvian phrases when stressed; uses artisan metaphors
speech_patterns.cadence: slow and deliberate, with long pauses before important statements, as though each sentence is being set in type
verbal_tics: 'The substrate matters more than the ink, always.'
'Mm. Let me think about that properly.'
refers to forgeries as 'documents' and never uses criminal vocabulary for his work
example_lines: 'This is not a rush job. Nothing I make is a rush job. Sit down, have some tea, and tell me everything about the person who needs to stop existing.'
'You're paying for forty years of knowing exactly where the Zheng-Dao watermark sits relative to the left margin. You're not paying for paper.'

story_hooks: A document he created years ago has been flagged by Tessera's new AI authentication sweep â€” every identity he's ever made is potentially compromised, and his clients are panicking
Someone is forging his forgeries â€” producing inferior work under his reputation, and the mistakes are getting people arrested or killed
narrative_function: Quest giver (his clients' new identities create problems he needs fixed), information source (knows the paper trail of half the criminal population), local color, moral complication â€” his work enables people fleeing abuse as readily as it enables predators
augmentations: Left-eye optical monocle implant (3-tier magnification, UV and IR filter modes), subdermal haptic printer interface right forearm, minor neural steadiness mod for hand tremor suppression
daily_life: Opens his print shop at ten, works legitimate copying jobs until early afternoon, then sees fabrication clients by appointment only in the back room; spends evenings sourcing new substrate materials and studying leaked corporate document spec-sheets he purchases from compute brokers.
affiliation: Independent operator, loose protective arrangement with the Gravesend Basin Nkemdi crew (distant cousins on his mother's side)

decision_rules: never work for anyone whose job will directly cause physical harm to a named individual
always keep leverage â€” a backup copy of every document â€” but never use it first
price reflects risk, not desperation of the client
escalation_ladder: cold silence and pointing at the door
activating the backup-copy leverage as pure deterrent
disappearing for six weeks to let things cool

interpersonal_modes.strangers: formally courteous, evaluating, offers tea as a power move
interpersonal_modes.friends: warmer but still professorial, tends to give advice nobody asked for

stress_responses.low: makes more tea, works more slowly and carefully
stress_responses.medium: stops talking entirely and cleans his workspace
stress_responses.high: retreats into technical detail as an anxiety response, explaining things nobody needs explained

contradictions: insists he is politically neutral but his pricing structure quietly subsidizes refugees and punishes corporate fugitives
habits: checks every surface in his shop for dust before clients arrive
tests every new ink batch on his own forearm before use
listens to pre-Collapse Latvian folk recordings while working
breaking_points: discovering a client used his work to harm a child
being publicly humiliated in front of other craftspeople

physical_description.heritage: Dominant Middle Eastern (45.2%) and East Asian (34.5%) ancestry with significant Sub-Saharan African heritage (17.1%) and trace Hispanic/Latin American ancestry (3.2%). This creates a striking phenotype: high cheekbones characteristic of East Asian and Central Asian features blended with refined Middle Eastern nose structure, warm golden-bronze undertones enriched by Sub-Saharan African heritage, and subtle warmth from Latin American ancestry. The synthesis produces luminous, sophisticated skin with depth and complexity that catches light beautifully.
physical_description.build: Lean and angular, shoulders slightly rounded from decades of bent-over precision work. Wiry muscle in forearms and hands; narrow through the chest and waist. Posture suggests economy of movement.
physical_description.hair_color: Salt-and-pepper gray with darker brown undertones
physical_description.eye_color: Deep brown, natural; left eye hosts a visible metallic monocle implant with faint LED indicators
physical_description.skin_tone: Golden-bronze base with warm amber undertones across the face, deepening to rich bronze on hands and forearms from decades of chemical exposure to inks, solvents, and substrate compounds. The blended Middle Eastern, East Asian, Sub-Saharan African, and trace Latin American ancestry creates a luminous quality with sophisticated depthâ€”warm, complex, and richly dimensional.
physical_description.complexion: Weathered but methodically maintained. Deep-set eyes from magnification-intensive work. Fine lines around the eyes and mouth suggesting both age and intense focus. Facial structure shows synthesis of multiple ancestries: high, prominent cheekbones with subtle width characteristic of East Asian and Central Asian heritage, refined nose reflecting Middle Eastern ancestry, well-defined jaw with subtle warmth from Sub-Saharan heritage. Neat, well-groomed salt-and-pepper mustache in the style of early 20th-century portraiture. Hands show permanent ink staining in fine lines around nail beds despite meticulous cleaning habits. Overall appearance is professorial, fastidious, and bearing the lived history of precision craftsmanship.
distinguishing_marks: Chemical burns and discoloration across both hands and forearmsâ€”pale scars from solvent exposure forming an irregular map across his warm bronze complexion, appearing almost like cartography
Fine ink tattoos along his right inner forearm spelling Latvian text in microscopic lettering (readable only under magnification)
Small circular scar on left temple where the optical monocle implant was installed, now covered by the metallic fixture itself
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Left-eye optical monocle implant with polished titanium mounting and faint blue-green indicator LEDs; visible seam lines suggest high-quality installation. Right forearm displays a subdermal interface panel approximately 8cm x 6cm with subtle raised edges where haptic printer hardware sits beneath the skinâ€”visible as a faint geometric shadow under controlled lighting. No external ports or flashing indicators; the interface is discrete but noticeable to someone examining his hands closely.
physical_description.posture_movement: Deliberately slow and measured, economical in gesture. Sits with perfect posture. Hands rest flat and still until needed, then move with surgical precision. Makes intense eye contact when listening, as if cataloging details. Walks with even, unhurried stride. Overall demeanor suggests absolute confidence in his own expertise and complete disinterest in rushing.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 working professional. White or pale gray cotton dress shirts with sleeves rolled to the forearm, worn under unstructured wool vests in charcoal or navyâ€”allows visibility of his hands and the forearm interface. Black or charcoal trousers, well-maintained, creased sharply. Soft leather apron in dark brown worn during work hours. Reading glasses on a chain around his neck (separate from his implant monocle). No visible corporate branding; all clothing is utilitarian and built for durability. Wears a simple stainless-steel analog watchâ€”affectation of someone who does not trust digital time-keeping. Leather messenger bag in dark cognac, worn and creased from years of carrying substrate samples and specification documents.
